comment: Pinned to .NET 10, the current LTS. The machine also has an 11.0 RC SDK installed and
would otherwise pick it: building a production service with a release-candidate compiler
is not reproducible, and net10.0 is what the target host will run.
rollForward latestFeature allows 10.0.x patch and feature updates, nothing above 10.
The test runner opt-in is required on the .NET 10 SDK: xunit.v3 runs on
Microsoft.Testing.Platform, and without this `dotnet test` still routes to the old VSTest
